army_rules.name: The Sons of Sanguinius
army_rules.rules_text: If an Adeptus Astartes unit has a second Faction keyword on its datasheet, that Faction keyword is the name of that unit's Chapter. For example, Lemartes has both the Adeptus Astartes and Blood Angels Faction keywords, and is therefore from the Blood Angels Chapter. You cannot include units from more than one Chapter in your army.

chapter_rules.name: The Sons of Sanguinius
chapter_rules.rules_text: Blood Angels armies cannot include Adeptus Astartes units drawn from more than one Chapter.

detachments.name: Angelic Inheritors

rule.name: Legacy of the Angel
rule.rules_text: Friendly BLOOD ANGELS CHARACTER units can re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and re-roll Wound rolls of 1.

restrictions: Your army can include BLOOD ANGELS units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

enhancements.name: Prescient Flash
enhancements.rules_text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This unit has Scouts 6".

enhancements.name: Blazing Icon
enhancements.rules_text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Enemy units cannot target this unit with Snap Shooting attacks.

enhancements.name: Ordained Sacrifice
enhancements.rules_text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Once per battle, per army, at the end of a phase in which this model is destroyed, roll one D6: on a 2+, set this model back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed, unengaged, with 3 wounds remaining.

enhancements.name: Unto Death
enhancements.rules_text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Once per battle, per army, in your Command phase you can use this ability. If you do, until the end of the turn this unit can re-roll Advance rolls and Charge rolls.

stratagems.name: Focused Fury
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's melee attacks have LETHAL HITS. If your unit is a CHARACTER unit, they have LETHAL HITS and LANCE.

stratagems.name: Strike Now for Glory
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to attack.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's ranged attacks have SUSTAINED HITS 1.

stratagems.name: Instant of Grace
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has CHARACTER until the start of your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: Measured Strategist
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: Unto the Burning Skies
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly THE SANGUINOR/unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES JUMP PACK unit.
stratagems.effect: Place your unit in Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.name: In the Shadow of Great Wings
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has Stealth and -3" detection range.

detachments.name: Encarmine Speartip

rule.name: Wrath of Angels
rule.rules_text: The tactical doctrine is active for SANGUINARY GUARD units in addition to any other combat doctrine.

restrictions: Your army can include BLOOD ANGELS units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

enhancements.name: Shadow of Abomination
enhancements.rules_text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES JUMP PACK model only. Once per battle, per army, when this unit is selected to fight you can use this ability. If you do, this model's melee attacks have +1 D.

enhancements.name: Angelic Executioner
enhancements.rules_text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES JUMP PACK model only. When this unit is selected to fight, this unit's melee attacks have LETHAL HITS or SUSTAINED HITS 1.

stratagems.name: Judgement of the Golden Host
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, when a friendly SANGUINARY GUARD unit ends a charge move.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. Roll one D6 for each model in your unit engaged with that enemy unit; for each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

stratagems.name: Inexorable Valour
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit engaged with a friendly SANGUINARY GUARD unit ends a Fall Back move, if that SANGUINARY GUARD unit is unengaged.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: Blinding Blurs of Vengeance
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly SANGUINARY GUARD unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has Stealth and -3" detection range.

detachments.name: Wrath of the Doomed

rule.name: Sanguinius' Fury
rule.rules_text: Friendly DEATH COMPANY units have the following: At the start of each phase, the assault doctrine is active for this unit. The devastator/tactical doctrine cannot be active for this unit. This means that, regardless of any other rules, DEATH COMPANY units can never have an active doctrine other than the assault doctrine.

restrictions: Your army can include BLOOD ANGELS units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

enhancements.name: Instinctive Interception
enhancements.rules_text: DEATH COMPANY model only. When you target this unit with the Heroic Intervention stratagem, that use is -1 CP.

enhancements.name: On the Archtraitor's Bridge
enhancements.rules_text: DEATH COMPANY model only. This model's melee attacks have +2 A.

stratagems.name: Death Begets Vengeance
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly DEATH COMPANY unit is destroyed by an enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: That enemy unit is hated until the end of the battle. While a unit is hated, friendly DEATH COMPANY units' attacks that target that unit have +1 to Wound rolls.

stratagems.name: No Barrier to Retribution
stratagems.when: Your Movement or Charge phase, when a friendly DEATH COMPANY DREADNOUGHT unit is selected to make a Normal/Advance/Charge move.

stratagems.name: Rage-Fuelled Response
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged DEATH COMPANY unit has shot.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Surge move of up to D6".
